Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with shortness of breath at rest four weeks after a Caesarean section.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: PC SOBAR, c section 4 weeks ago

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Shortness of breath at rest began acutely while the patient was watching television.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: SOBAR while watching tv, acute onset.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had an unproductive cough one day prior to presentation.
The dyspnea is not affected by body position.
Patient underwent a Caesarean section 2–3 weeks ago without complications and the baby is well.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: C section 2-3 weeks ago. No complications, baby well.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is not taking any blood-thinning medication.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient reports no significant past medical history.

Medications.content: Patient is not on anticoagulant therapy (blood thinners).

Physical_Findings.content: Heart rate measured via telephone is approximately 120 bpm, tachycardic but regular.
Physical_Findings.source_text: Oex HR via telephone roughly 120bpm . tachy, regular

Family_History.content: Patient's mother has a history of blood clots in her legs.
Family_History.source_text: Mother hx of clots on legs.

Assessment.content: Pulmonary embolism is considered in the differential diagnosis.

Plan_of_Care.content: Plan is to conduct further examination and investigations in an acute setting.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Plan : Further examination and investigation in acute setting.
